bottom_line: Every menu method has a complete formal termination proof, but from two different kernels: A and D are CeTA (Isabelle-kernel) certified via TTT2 on the identical TRS; B, C, E are Lean-kernel proved. B has a failed/MAYBE TTT2 polynomial artifact, C has no successful TTT2 MPO artifact, and E is not expressible as a TTT2 exponential-interpretation strategy. The artifact pack therefore records TTT2/CeTA certification only where it exists, and Lean-kernel certification for the remaining exact prompt methods.
